Top candidates: Gray_Mold (gray fuzzy growth), Late_Blight (large dark irregular lesions), Early_Blight (concentric rings).

The grayish dusty texture on the necrotic area is most distinctive. Viewing a Gray_Mold reference.

The Gray_Mold reference shows fruit rot with gray fuzzy growth. My test image shows a leaf lesion — large, dark brown with a grayish dusty coating on the necrotic tissue. This grayish sporulation on leaf tissue is characteristic of Botrytis (Gray Mold). Late Blight shows water-soaked dark lesions; Early Blight shows concentric rings — neither matches as well.
